affected.product: Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service

descriptions.value: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. If a low-privileged attacker is able to convince a victim to visit a URL referencing a vulnerable page, malicious JavaScript content may be executed within the context of the victim's browser. Scope is changed.
